title: Polynomial closure under products
statement: Let $P$ and $R$ be polynomially bounded functions from the natural numbers to the natural numbers, and let $c$ be a natural number. Then the function $n\mapsto c(P(n)+1)(R(n)+2)$ is polynomially bounded.
replaced: Let $P$ and $R$ be polynomially bounded functions on the naturals and let $c$ be a constant. Then the function $n \mapsto c\,(P(n)+1)(R(n)+2)$ is polynomially bounded.
